title: Loaded Shredded Chicken Tacos
description: Saucy shredded chicken with capsicum, beans, corn and a smoky, mole-ish edge. Spoon straight into tacos.

items.note: Or a small square of dark chocolate

steps.text: Add the onion ({{onion}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) and capsicum ({{capsicum}}) to the bowl. Chop 4 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.
Add the olive oil ({{oil}}). Sauté 3 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

Add the chicken ({{chicken}}), then all the spices, the tomato paste ({{tomato-paste}}), diced tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), chipotle and adobo, brown sugar ({{brown-sugar}}), cocoa ({{cocoa}}), bay leaf and water ({{water}}). Cook 20 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir, until tender.
Remove the bay leaf. Shred 8 sec / Reverse / Speed 4, leaving the sauce in so the chicken stays moist.
Add the black beans ({{beans}}) and corn ({{corn}}). Cook 3 min / 90°C / Reverse / Speed 1, just to warm through.
Stir through the lime juice and coriander ({{coriander}}). Taste, adjust, and spoon into warm tortillas.

notes.title: Salt
notes.text: Held back deliberately. Chipotle, adobo, tomatoes and beans all carry salt. Taste after shredding and adjust then.

notes.title: Chicken breast
notes.text: Works well since it braises in the sauce and shreds cleanly. Cut into 3–4cm chunks, check at 15 minutes, and pull it as soon as it shreds easily.

notes.title: If it is too loose
notes.text: After shredding, cook a couple of minutes at 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1 with the MC off to let steam escape.

notes.title: To serve
notes.text: Warm tortillas with avocado, grated cheese, shredded lettuce or cabbage, sour cream and extra lime.
